spots.note: Five players behind: linear, strong range. Small pairs and suited wheel aces play well; offsuit broadways below KQ/AJ get dominated.

spots.note: Four behind: add suited kings/connectors and ATo/KJo. Still no offsuit junk.

spots.title: CO · folded to you
spots.line: Folded to you in the CO. 100bb. Open 2.5bb or fold?
spots.note: Three behind: wide steal. Suited hands down to K4s/Q6s, offsuit broadways, A8o+.

spots.title: BTN · folded to you
spots.line: Folded to you in the BTN. 100bb. Open 2.5bb or fold?
spots.note: Only the blinds behind + position all hand: open ~45%. Any suited king, most suited queens, every offsuit ace.

spots.title: SB · folded to you
spots.line: Folded to you in the SB. 100bb. Open 3bb or fold?
spots.note: Raise-or-fold baseline vs BB (3x). Solvers mix limps at low rake, but for your VPIP/PFR leak the drill treats every limp as wrong.
